name: 23673-longprompt-125m-1gpu
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, one engine process.
architecture: Dense decoder, OPTForCausalLM: 12 layers, 12 heads, hidden 768, ffn 3072, vocab 50272, learned absolute positions, max_position_embeddings 2048, torch_dtype float16, 125M params (~0.25 GB fp16).
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=1024, bounded at 10000 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup the first 10% and cooldown the last 10% by completion.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets: prompts exactly 1500 tokens, outputs exactly 150 (the backend forces ignore_eos=True when max_tokens is set), every prompt distinct. `request_format: plain` is REQUIRED, not cosmetic -- this checkpoint's tokenizer carries no chat_template and the default format raises before the first request.
purpose: A document summarizer condensing 1500-token passages into short briefs for a thousand concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# pinned deliberately, NOT the async path's defaults: leaving these unset admits far fewer than
# 1024 sequences and clamps the declared operating point
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 16384

disable-log-stats: true
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
enable-prefix-caching: true
